canonical_project: UP Data Centre Park - Agra (state programme)
owner: Government of Uttar Pradesh (InvestUP / UP Electronics Corporation)
notes: UP government plans eight data centre parks (Noida, Greater Noida, Yamuna Expressway/Jewar, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Agra) under the revised DC policy, targeting 900 MW and ~Rs 2 lakh crore investment. ETDatacenters (Apr 2026) states that for Kanpur, Varanasi and Agra, site identification and master-plan preparation are in progress. No district-specific Agra capacity or developer named yet.
